# People Atlas 0.5.0

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.5.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This release makes People Atlas Settings easier to navigate while preserving
existing vault data and explicit relationship-template behavior.

Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
step from this GitHub release.

## Changes

- Reorganized Settings into **General**, **People schema**, **Relationships**,
  **Contact moments**, and **View & Bases**. Existing setting keys, defaults,
  validation, and searchability remain unchanged.
- Added an Obsidian-native confirmation dialog before deleting a relationship
  template that is still referenced by relationship notes. Confirming deletion
  keeps copied relationship types and roles on those notes; only template
  provenance no longer points to an existing template.
- Made declarative Settings controls await the established persistence boundary
  so host-side save and rollback handling completes before a control update
  resolves.
- Stabilized the canonical multi-project test runner without reducing test
  coverage or browser-matrix coverage.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
